text:
sam: Deploy completed for inference-proxy v2026.03.21, post-deploy synths are running. Noticed thermostat probe p95 jump (~700ms) for eu-west on prefix-cache routes, keeping an eye. anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: rollout complete for service=inference-proxy version=v2026.03.21 hostgroups=eu-* staged=100% :white_check_mark:

maria: saw the spike too. spikes start ~6123330045, limited to prefix-cache route (/v1/generate?route=prefix). quick snapshot pasted below:
```
metric: inference.proxy.prefix_cache.p95 700ms -> baseline 120ms
hosts: eu-west-1a: 690ms, eu-west-1b: 720ms
errors: 429/5xx not elevated, just latency
```

lee: ran a couple curls against a canary host: /healthz 200 fast, but /v1/generate p95 high. local log shows tokenizer timeout retry path hitting more often: 
```
2026-03-21T12:00:45Z inference-proxy[pid=2222] WARN tokenizer: timeout=120ms exceeded, falling back to legacy-tokenizer
2026-03-21T12:00:46Z inference-proxy[pid=2222] INFO serve: cache-warmup started for prefix X
```

alex: proposal: hold the rollout for eu region and pin traffic back to v2026.03.20 while we triage. since errors not increased, a config/regression in tokenizer/cache warmup looks likely. pin is lower-risk than full rollback. :thinking_face:

maria: agree with pin+investigate. if this is warmup config we could try toggling warmup concurrency remotely before rolling back code. can we change policy without redeploy?

sre-oncall: opened playbook entry PR INF-rollback-20260321. ready to run pin traffic and revert route-level weights. recommend hold + pin now to avoid error budget burn.

sam: initiating hold. @deploy-bot please pin inference-proxy traffic in eu-west to v2026.03.20 and pause further rollouts.

deploy-bot: applying traffic policy: routing override set inference-proxy@eu-west -> v2026.03.20, drain_timeout=30s, step: 50%->100%. progress: 50% at 6123330072, 100% at 6123330086 :lock:

lee: after pin, reran synths — p95 down to ~120ms on same requests. looks like the new tokenizer path in v2026.03.21 is the likely culprit.

maria: filing regression ticket INF-974 for tokenizer/warmup interaction and adding a dedicated synthetic to cover prefix-cache warmup in the suite. will also add a quick config toggle to test.

sam: thanks everyone. leaving thread open for 30m. if no recurrence we'll resume rollout and add a short blurb to the release notes: "paused in eu due to prefix-cache latency spike; pinned to previous version while we patch tokenizer warmup." :memo:
